dialog.title: Before you start
dialog.intro: A few things to set up before you start. Permission mode starts as Ask.

dialog.toolsReady: npm and the browser are ready. Test all in Settings → Dependencies checks the rest.
dialog.packagesBody: Install them from Settings → Packages → Recommended. They add per-turn review and undo, diagnostics, subagents, and worktrees. Installing needs npm.
dialog.npmRequiredBody: Pi installs packages with npm, and it is not working on this computer.
